text: I've had this cough going on for about two months now. speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant finding. text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation with flattened diaphragms, increased retrosternal airspace and a prominent hilar shadow suggestive of emphysema.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome secondary to pulmonary involvement (likely due to underlying pathology such as a pituitary adenoma or ectopic ACTH secretion). The combination of chronic cough, emphysematous changes on X-ray, and confirmed hypercortisolism indicates systemic metabolic disruption affecting the lungs. I recommend immediate endocrine evaluation to identify the source of excess cortisol production.
